name: Social media manager
summary: Plans and writes a business's posts, captions and short videos, and answers comments and messages. Keeps a steady schedule that sounds like the business.

changelog.note: First release: how Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn and X rank posts as of Nov 2026 from the platforms' own pages, originality rules, ad and AI disclosure in the US, UK and EU, four skills (content plan, platform-native posts, short video scripts, comment and message replies), six prompts, three workflows and training material, with 29 checked sources. The agent drafts; the client posts.
